name: Princess Cream
source:
Is it because she was raised carefully and had a sheltered life? She cannot even take off her clothes by herself.

Never doubted her own future and thought she will be wedded to the prince.

A princess possessing a deeply jealous personality and is scatterbrained.

"How about the prince? Please deeply deeply love me, okay? ...Ah?... What do you mean by 'You should take off yours clothes?'"

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=850479]Getchu[/url]]
